programme.title: Hemmetin Joulu
programme.desc: Telepaattisia kykyjä omaava koira pakenee sulkutilasta- ja juoksee suoraan kahden nuoren veljen rakastavaan syliin. Washingtonin johto ei luovu salaisesta aseestaan helpolla.

programme.title: Joulu tilauksesta
programme.desc: Gretchen saa joulun tapahtua missä ja milloin tahansa.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Love The Coopers
programme.desc: Cooperien iso perhe kokoontuu viettämään joulua yhdessä, mutta perinteisiä kuvioita sotkevat yllätysvieraat.

programme.title: Joulumaa
programme.desc: Joulumaa on nähnyt parempiakin päiviä Glindan menehdyttyä, ja Julesin täytyy tehdä valtavia päätöksiä.

programme.title: A Perfect Christmas List
programme.desc: Hiljattain sairaalaan joutunut isoäiti antaa viimeisenä toiveenaan tyttärelleen Michellelle ja tyttärentyttärelleen Saralle listan ennen joulua yhdessä tehtävistä juhlatunnelmaa nostattavista asioista toivoen, että näiden kahden kokema seikkailu korjaisi heidän suhteensa.

programme.title: Ihme Joulujärvellä
programme.desc: Kun teinipoika menettää parhaan ystävänsä ja isänsä joulun aikaan- hän lopettaa lempilajinsa jääkiekon ja jättää ystävänsä. Kun jääkaukalo ilmestyy jäätyneelle järvelle hänen kotinsa lähelle, hän muistelee hyviä aikoja.

programme.title: Lähetys joulua
programme.desc: Kun hänen lähetyskumppaninsa päättää lähteä Amerikan suosikkiaamuohjelmasta, Veronika Daniels ilmoittaa valitsevansa uuden juontajakansa kourallisen ehdokkaiden joukosta, joihin kuuluu paikallinen New Yorkin uutislähettäjä Charlie Fisher.

programme.title: Bennettin Laulujuhla
programme.desc: Rva Song odottaa vauvaa 14 adoptiolapsen joukkoonsa, ja perhe lyöttäytyy yhteen pysäyttääkseen rakennuttajan, joka haluaa sulkea monitoimitalon. Rakkaus, tiimityö ja joulun taika pelastavat päivän.

programme.title: Avain Jouluun
programme.desc: Kun tyytymätön tonttu valtaa pohjoisnavan, hän kääntää ajan taaksepäin, ja joulupukki alkaa nuortua nopeasti! Uskollisen tontun, pikkutytön, jolla on taika-avain- ja teini-ikäisen joulupukin on pelastettava joulun tulevaisuus.

programme.title: Joulu Kruunun Kera
programme.desc: Kipinät lentävät, kun komea muukalainen tarjoutuu - auttamaan menestyvää naista järjestämään perheen joulufestivaalin. Oikeasti hän on valepuvussa oleva prinssi. Vaaditaan kuninkaallinen ihme, jotta heidän sydämensä yhtyvät.

programme.title: A Christmas in Royal Fashion
programme.desc: Kansainvälisen PR-yrityksen kaunis ja lahjakas assistentti Kristin Cooper saa vastuulleen vaatealalla työskentelevän liikemies Carsonin vuotuisen joulun muotinäytöksen ja huutokaupan järjestämisen.

programme.title: Puppy Star Christmas
programme.desc: Pup Star -perhe on kasvanut! Uusien pentujen, Cindyn, Rosien, Charlien ja Brodyn tulee oppia, mitä joulu oikeasti tarkoittaa. Kun Pup Starin pahikset juonivat pilaavansa joulun, pennut päätyvät pohjoisnavalle pelastamaan joulupukin ja jouluhengen...

programme.title: Joulun ihmemaa
programme.desc: Joulun aika NYC:ssä on kaikkea muuta kuin ihanaa kamppailevalle taiteilija Heidi Neillille.

programme.title: Jouluhäät
programme.desc: Haley Foster pakeni lapsuutensa pikkukaupungista Pineridgestä ja siirtyi suurkaupunkilaiselämään losangelesilaisena hääjärjestelijänä rva Reynoldsin omistamassa eliittiluokan yrityksessä.

programme.title: Kuuhullut (Moonstruck)
programme.desc: Tässä klassisessa romanttisessa komediassa Brooklynin leski (Cher) on valmis menemään uudelleen naimisiin. Tällä kertaa hän aikoo tehdä sen oikein, vaikka joutuisikin sanomaan ”kyllä” miehelle, jota hän ei oikeasti rakasta.

programme.title: Pähkinänsärkijä-makeinen
programme.desc: Silberhausin lapset olivat innoissaan jouluaaton juhlallisuuksista, kun heidän kummisetänsä antoi heille aikaisen joululahjan, Pähkinänsärkijän, joka johti taisteluun lelusotilaiden - ja Hiirikuninkaan johtaman kamalan hiirijoukkueen välillä.

programme.title: 12 Joulukoiraa: Suuri koiranpentupelastus
programme.desc: Dovervillen lapset kilpailevat aikaa ja mahdollisuuksia vastaan- pelastaakseen koiraorpokodin häikäilemättömältä pohatalta.

programme.title: Joulun alla
programme.desc: CHRISTMAS UNDER WRAPS, esittelee Candace Cameron Buren tohtori Lauren Brunellin roolissa, joka hyväksyy työpaikan Alaskassa menetettyään sekä poikaystävänsä että arvostetun leikkausapurahansa, mutta saa tietää, että kyseessä on pieni sairaala pikkukaupungissa.

programme.title: 12 Joulukoiraa
programme.desc: Leski-isä lähettää tyttärensä tätinsä luo kaupunkiin, joka on kieltänyt koirat. Kun hän päättää pitää kulkukoiran, hän haluaa auttaa koiria - ja hurmata pormestarin ikimuistoisimmalla joulunäytelmällä.

programme.title: Jouluharmonia
programme.desc: Lahjakkaan laulaja-lauluntekijän sydän särkyy, kun kuuluisa muusikkopoikaystävä jättää hänet juuri ennen joulua. Hän palaa kotikaupunkiinsa löytääkseen uudelleen musiikin, romantiikan, perheen ja joulun taian.

programme.title: Joulukievari
programme.desc: Kun liikenainen Jennifer kuulee vanhempiensa lähtevän matkoille jouluksi ilman häntä, hän päättää jättää San Franciscon humun taakseen ja lähteä Alaskaan tutustumaan isoäidiltään perinnöksi saamaansa kievarrin, joka on tarkoitus kunnostaa ja myydä.

programme.title: Joulukuponki
programme.desc: Luistelumestari alkaa opettaa luistelutunteja, mutta kun hänen entinen lukiorakkaansa (ja nyt kuuluisa jääkiekkoilija) tuo veljentyttärensä tunneille, joulu on täynnä toista mahdollisuutta rakkauteen.

programme.title: Tyler Perry's a Madea Christmas
programme.desc: Madea juhlistaa joulua yhdessä ystävänsä ja tämän maalla asuvan perheen kanssa. Nyt on parasta olla kilttinä!

programme.title: Joulu tilauksesta
programme.desc: Gretchen saa joulun tapahtua missä ja milloin tahansa.

programme.title: 12 Gifts of Christmas
programme.desc: Työtön taidemaalari Anna kamppailee taloutensa kanssa, mutta löytää työpaikan kireän liikemiehen Marcin henkilökohtaisena jouluostosten tekijänä.

programme.title: Tonttumies
programme.desc: Joulupukki jättää jälkeensä tontun, joka pelastaa Harperin perheen kurjalta joululta. Tonttu perheineen saa enemmän kuin halusi. Lapset auttavat tonttua löytämään voimansa - ja identiteettinsä orastavana supersankarina.

programme.title: Deck the Halls
programme.desc: Menestysmysteerikirjailija Mary Higgins Clarkin romaaniin perustuva elokuva nähdään jouluna salapoliisitarinana. Naisetsivä lyöttäytyy yksiin amatöörietsivän kanssa löytääkseen kadonneen isänsä.

programme.title: Joulukuppikakkuja
programme.desc: Kun perheen leipomo joutuu ehkä sulkemaan ovensa juuri ennen joulua - siskokset Kimin ja Ginan on lyöttäydyttävä yhteen - voittaakseen leivontakilpailun, pelastaakseen perheyrityksen - ja ehkä jopa löytääkseen isomman palkinnon kuin toivoivat.

programme.title: Maanviljelijä ja Belle Pelastavat Joulumaan
programme.desc: Kipinät lentävät kuuluisan mallin ja maanviljelijän välillä- kun tämä vierailee lapsuudenkodissaan. Kaupunki on vaarassa menettää rakkaan Joulumaan festivaalinsa- mutta rakkaus, perhe ja usko voivat tehdä ihmeitä.

programme.title: Thanks for Sharing
programme.desc: Päällepäin ympäristökonsultti Adamilla, yksityisyrittäjä Mikellä ja ensiapulääkäri Neilillä ei ole mitään yhteistä, mutta he kaikki ovat mukana 12 askeleen ohjelmassa kohti vapautta riippuvuuksistaan.

programme.title: Amateur Night
programme.desc: Jason Biggs esittää Guyta, palkittua, vasta valmistunutta arkkitehtia. Nyt hän on kuitenkin työtön, tuleva isä, joka etsii epätoivoisesti töitä. Vaimonsa vaatimuksesta Guy vastaa netti-ilmoitukseen, jossa etsitään ”kuljettajaa”.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Mies joka tiesi liian vähän
programme.desc: Yhdysvaltalainen videokaupan työntekijä luulee osallistuvansa katuteatteriesitykseen, jolloin häntä luullaan erehdyksessä kansainväliseksi vakoojaksi. Hän luovii tiensä läpi kokonaisen vakoiluverkoston päihittäen samalla Euroopan parhaimmat salamurhaajat.

programme.title: Smart People
programme.desc: Tyytymätön vaimonsa kuolemaan, englanninopettaja masentuu ja katkeroituu, mutta löytää silti mahdollisuuden uuteen rakkauteen.

programme.title: Vampyyrien Imussa
programme.desc: Becca, angstinen teini uudessa koulussa, päätyykeskelle kahden yliluonnollisen kosijan soidintanssia– toinen heistä oikukas vampyyri ja toinenkäsittämättömän karvainen ihmissusi. ScaryMovien tekijätiimin hervoton revittely!

programme.title: The Female Brain
programme.desc: Mikä saa naisen swaippaamaan oikeaan herra Väärän ja vasempaan herra Oikean kohdalla? Suoraviivainen neurologi Julia tutkii miesten ja naisten aivojen eroja, jotka esitellään kolmen eri suhteen vaiheessa olevan pariskunnan elämän kautta.

programme.title: How To Be A Latin Lover
programme.desc: Maximolla on unelma: hän haluaa tulla rikkaaksi tekemättä päivääkään töitä. Hän opettelee viettelemään rikkaita, vanhempia naisia ja päätyy naimisiin reilusti vanhemman naisen kanssa.

programme.title: What Just Happened?
programme.desc: Viikko Hollywood-tuottajan Benin elämässä. Ben neuvottelee studiojohtajan kanssa, jotta hänen uusin elokuvansa saisi ensi-iltansa Cannesissa kahden viikon kuluttua. Hän on hermostunut ohjaaja, jonka on tehtävä editointi elokuvaan.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone on Long Islandin paras lennonjohtaja, kunnes hiljainen muukalainen, Russell Bell, siirretään hänen osastolleen. Näiden New York TRACONin kahden huippulennonjohtajan välinen kilvoittelu eskaloituu mahdollisesti vaaralliselle tasolle.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: Karannutta vankia jahtaava agentti Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) lähtee suorittamaan peitetehtävää ja pukeutuu määräileväksi ja isokokoiseksi mummoksi, joka mottaa yhtä kovaa kuin komentaakin.

programme.title: Love The Coopers
programme.desc: Cooperien iso perhe kokoontuu viettämään joulua yhdessä, mutta perinteisiä kuvioita sotkevat yllätysvieraat.

programme.title: Management
programme.desc: Lasillinen samppanjaa ja taputus pepulle voi viedä pitkälle! Turhautunut uranainen myyntimatkalla ja sekopäinen motellinjohtaja, joka pitää halvasta samppanjasta ja pyöreästä takapuolesta? Ei kuulosta hyvältä yhdistelmältä, mutta mitä vaan voi tapahtua autiossa tienvarsihotellissa...

programme.title: Peace, Love And Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Komedia menestyksekkäästä newyorkilaisesta asianajajasta (Catherine Keener), joka tuo mukanaan kaksi vilkasta teini-ikäistä lastaan hippiäitinsä (Jane Fonda) luo maalle perhelomalle.

programme.title: The Wedding Guest
programme.desc: Sarja huvittavia ja onnettomia kohtauksia vain vahvistaa, että hän on rakastuneempi kuin koskaan.

programme.title: Talo jossa kello tikittää
programme.desc: Talo jossa kello tikittää kertoo taianomaisen tarinan 10-vuotiaasta Lewisistä, joka muuttaa enonsa luokse vanhaan, narisevaan taloon, jonka uumenissa tikittää mystisesti.

programme.title: A Little Something For Your Birthday
programme.desc: Aloitteleva muotisuunnittelija kamppailee menestyksen ja rakkauden löytämiseksi. Tarina sijoittuu hänen elämäänsä kerran vuodessa, aina samana päivänä: hänen syntymäpäivänään.

programme.title: Man About Town
programme.desc: Jack Giamoro elää amerikkalaista unelmaa. Hän on Hollywoodin halutuin kykyjenetsijä. Nopeita autoja, paljon rahaa ja kaunis vaimo - you name it, Jack's got it.

programme.title: Love, Weddings And Other Disasters
programme.desc: Monitarinainen romanttinen komedia ihmisistä, jotka työkseen järjestävät hääjuhlia.

programme.title: Fanboys
programme.desc: Joukko Star Wars -faneja matkustaa Skywalker Ranchille varastaakseen kopion elokuvasta The Phantom Menace, jotta heidän kuolemansairas ystävänsä ehtisi nähdä sen ennen sen ensi-iltaa, joka on vasta usean kuukauden päästä.

programme.title: Never Too Late
programme.desc: Neljä Vietnamin sodan vankileiriltä selvinnyttä veteraania päättää suorittaa viimeisen pakonsa - vanhainkodista. Pakosuunnitelman työstäminen seniilissä porukassa tuo kuitenkin omat haasteensa.

programme.title: Perhe - August: Osage County
programme.desc: Perhe tuo esiin jokaisen jäsenensä parhaat puolet - ja huonoimmat. Perhe - August: Osage County on tummasävyinen, hauska ja koskettava tarina Westonin perheen voimakastahtoisista naisista, jotka elämä on kuljettanut erilleen.

programme.title: Epic Movie
programme.desc: Tarina keskittyy neljään ei-niin-nuoreen orpoon: yhden heistä on kasvattanut Louvren kuraattori; toinen on pakolainen meksikolaisesta vapaapainista; kolmas äskettäinen hänen lentokoneessaan olleiden käärmeiden uhri; ja neljäs normaali asukas mutantti X -yhteisöstä.

programme.title: Tamara Drewe
programme.desc: Lontoossa toimittajan töitä tekevän Tamara Drewen lapsuudenkoti menee myyntiin, ja nuori nainen palaa juurilleen Dorsetin maaseutuidylliin. Lähtiessään Tamara oli kömpelö, isonenäinen teinityttö, palatessaan tulikuuma viettelijätär, joka sekoittaa hetkessä kyläläisten verkkaisen elämänmenon.

programme.title: The Right Kind of Wrong
programme.desc: Leo Palamino on epäonnistunut kirjailija, josta tuli tiskaaja. Nyt hänet tunnetaan ex-vaimon pitämästä blogista “Miksi olet paska”, josta on tullut suuri hitti. Sitten Leo tapaa Coletten, unelmiensa naisen… päivänä, jona Colette on menossa naimisiin täydellisen miehen kanssa.

programme.title: Mortdecai
programme.desc: Charlie Mortdecai on hurmaava taiteentuntija ja nautiskelija, jolla on kalliit elämäntavat. Hän ryhtyy yhdessä brittiläisen MI5-tiedustelupalvelunkanssa etsimään varastettua maalausta.

programme.title: 2 Night Stand
programme.desc: Toisinaan sitä kaipaa vain yhden yön juttua... ja sen jälkeen tekee mieli poistua mahdollisimman nopeasti takavasemmalle! Entä jos sankka lumimyrsky on tukkinut kaikki kaikki pakotiet, ja on mahdotonta poistua nolosta tilanteesta?

programme.title: The Way Way Back
programme.desc: Rantakaupunkilomallaan 14-vuotias Duncan vieraantuu äidistään, joka pyrkii päättäväisesti saamaanuuden parisuhteensa toimimaan.

programme.title: Majava
programme.desc: Majavasta voi olla apua sinullekin! Walter Blackin huumori on yhtä mustaa kuin hänen sukunimensä. Töissä menee huonosti, vaimo on saanut tarpeekseen ja poika vihaa isäänsä.

programme.title: Lost Canyon
programme.desc: When Johnny Travers (Jay Kirby) is falsely accused of robbing a bank, it's up to Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) to clear his name and find the real villains. There's nothing better than watching Hoppy get rough with the rustlers, and it's all the better when you get to hear the Sportsmen Quartette sing (I got Spurs) Jingle, Jangle, Jingle.

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as Fuzzy Q. Jones.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Randolph Scott plays James Barlow, an agent from Chicago hired to bring the notorious Reno brothers to justice. But wouldnt you know it? The Reno gang includes a beautiful young woman (Mala Powers), who catches Barlows eye. This western from director Tim Whelan (The Thief of Bagdad) features cinematography by two-time Oscar winner Ray Rennahan (Gone With The Wind), while the screenplay was by noted author Horace McCoy (They Shoot Horses, Dont They?). Theres also an all-star cast, including Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Edgar Buchanan, Denver Pyle, and several other shaggy sidewinders!

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, he's falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: Red Ryder encounters bandits trying to hold up the stagecoach carrying the owner of the Devil's Hole newspaper, Libby Brooks and her brother Gerry. Red successfully drives off the attackers but becomes embroiled in further conflict, leading to a duel that nearly claims his life.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A THRILLING TALE OF REVENGE AND REDEMPTION! Based on the story Triple Cross for Danger by the widely lauded Western author Walter J. Coburn, Fighting Fury is a thrilling take on the Western revenge drama. Portraying both a father and his son, star of silent and sound cowboy adventure films, Jack Hoxie (Trouble Busters, Law and Lawless) exudes the classic American rustic charm that still defines the genre. The film spins the yarn of Clay Hill Jr. (Hoxie), a Spanish-American boy raised by a Mexican servant who vows bloody vengeance on three malicious ranchers after they murder his parents and turn his life upside down. Featuring fine supporting performances from genre heavies Helen Holmes, Buck Conners and Western mainstay Fred Kohler.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin (Tall in the Saddle) spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cow town of Abilene, Kansas, coaxing fine performances from the likes of Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Thonda Fleming, and Lloyd Bridges. Saddle up and hang on!

programme.title: Shine on Harvest Moon
programme.desc: Jackson and his gang are cattle rustlers holed up in Jackson Hole Wyoming. Roy's partner Brower was once Jackson's partner and is now suspected of being in cahoots with him. Someone is tipping off Jackson as to the cattle's whereabouts and when Roy learns who it is he has a plan to trap Jackson and clear his partner. Starring Roy Rogers, Lynne Roberts, and Myrtle Wiseman as 'Lulu Belle. Directed by Joseph Kane.

programme.title: Days of Jesse James
programme.desc: Famed American western actor and singer Roy Rogers once again plays himself in this Jesse James tale that's a twist on the familiar formula. When he is summoned to bring Jesse to justice after the known villain is suspected of a bank robbery, Rogers soon discovers that Jesse has been framed and that the owner of the bank has robbed his own bank posing as Jesse. Fast-paced and fun, this classic Roy Rogers western directed by Joseph Kane (Dakota) features a whole host of original songs sung by the great Rogers himself.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Murder among ranchers is the subject of this Republic Pictures drama. Starring such names as Rex Allen, Slim Pickins, and Chester Clute, this feature was directed by William Whitney. For Trivia Buffs: At one time Whitney was known as the youngest director in Hollywood, having been hired by the newly formed Republic Pictures at the tender age of 21.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951!

programme.title: Enemy of the Law
programme.desc: Tex Ritter stars in this western drama about a man who goes undercover to befriend a convict believed to have stolen a shipment of government gold. Also starring Guy Wilkerson as Panhandle Perkins, this offering from Hollywoods Poverty Row features the usual fistfights and entertaining storyline that made these modestly budgeted features well worth watching. Songs include Teach Me To Forget and You Will Have to Pay both sung by Tex!

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Six Gun Trail
programme.desc: Legendary cowboy star Tim McCoy stars as Captain William Carson, who along with his sidekick Magpie does battle with jewel thieves. Its an actionfilled drama of the West, with plenty of blazing guns and heman adventure! There are a couple of songs, too, including Moon Over the Plains but they arent sung by Tim McCoy. He was too darned tough to sing! Also starring Nora Lane, Ben Corbet; directed by Sam Newfield.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as Fuzzy Q. Jones.

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: The end of the Mexican-American War finds a brazen U.S. Calvary captain and his men taking over a Spanish land grant. Albert C. Gannaway (The Badge of Marshall Brennan) directs an all-star cast including Jim Davis (Jock Ewing of Dallas), Arleen Whelan (Young Mr. Lincoln) and Lee Van Cleef (The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly). Also, look for appearances by legendary country And western stars Marty Robbins and Faron Young.

programme.title: The Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: A mining engineer tries to solve the murders of several heirs to a valuable radium mine in this western drama from Paramount Pictures. Stars include Charles Chic Sale, and in one of his early roles, Randolph Scott. This feature, also known as Rocky Mountain Mystery, was directed by Oscar winner Charles Barton, who would go on to direct several popular television shows, including Petticoat Junction and Family Affair...

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: A love story and a search for gold in the Valley of Death! Dubbed simple, powerful and dramatic by the New York Times on the date of its release, Death Valley is indeed an elegant depiction of love and deception in the American desert during the Gold Rush. In what was to be the final film of famed silent film director Paul Powell (Polyanna), a cast of mostly unknown actors produces uniformly excellent work. Lyrical and graceful, Powells film spins the tale of a young boy who finds love and gold, only to have it stolen from him.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
programme.desc: GENE AUTRY COMES ROARING OUT OF THE SKIES...to save the forests from an outlaw lumber ring! When ex forest ranger Gene tries to interfere with a gang destroying the timberland, hes framed for cattle-poisoning and set up for a murder charge. Yet, he still has time to sing some great cowboy songs, including Its My Lazy Day, and Hair of Gold. This is Gene Autry in a slightly different role, with some great footage filmed at Big Bear Valley and San Bernardino National Forest.

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, he's falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: The Two Gun Man
programme.desc: Ken Maynard stars in this vintage western about ranchers under threat from hired gunmen. Director Phil Rosen, whose career dated back to working with Thomas Edison and included several Charlie Chan features, keeps the action hot with help from a strong ensemble, including Charles King, Murdock MacQuarrie, and a horse named Tarzan! Maynard plays Blackie Weed, a marshall going undercover to capture and arrest some cattle rustlers.He finds himself up against some very bad men, and he's soon framed for murder. Watch as Blackie blazes his way to vindication with a .45 in either hand and the flame of righteous anger in his eyes... Kitty: Nita Martin. Joe Kearney: Lafe McKee. Lem Tolliver: Tom London. Ranch Foreman: Walter Perry

programme.title: Young Bill Hickock
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars as the title character in this actionpacked feature from Republic Pictures. Starring Sally Payne as Calamity Jane, and Rogerss ongoing sidekick George Gabby Hayes, this twofisted saga relives some of Americas most colorful days, and also has time for a few musical numbers, including Up and Down the Prairie, and When the Shadows Fall Across the Rockies.

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
programme.desc: A long-thought-lost film finally surfaces after being unseen for over eight decades. Created and copyrighted by Sunset Productions in 1925 but not released until June 15, 1927, this silent epic features the superior Native American actor Chief Yowlachie (performing here under the name Chief Yowlache) as Sitting Bull. Other fine actors in the cast include the always popular Bryant Washburn and a young Bob Steele, who appears under his real name Bob Bradbury Jr. The story takes place in the 1860s or 1870s near Spirit Lake, Iowa. Settlements of whites are growing in that region but the Sioux Indians also have professed their interest in one such settlement. Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and with the advice of the Great Spirit vows to retake the land that belonged to his fathers.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney are ordered to San Pablo, Mexico, to find out what's behind the trouble an American tungsten mine is having. When they arrive, they discover the mine has been closed, the wells are all poisoned and the town is in the grip of a malaria epidemic. To make matters worse, the lawmen have been followed by four gunslingers determined to give the American troubleshooters all the trouble they can handle - and more. Russell Hayden stars.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In this episode, Pat and Stoney tangle with a gang of robbers who have hijacked an Army payroll. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan. Originally aired on NBC.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In an episode called Koniakers, G-Men Pat Gallagher and Stoney Crockett investigate how U.S. currency in a bank vault was replaced by counterfeit money. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West. In this episode, Pat and Stoney get reports that a man is selling salted mines to investors. The two G-men are determined to discover the truth. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Kate tries to teach Betty Jo how to make hot rhubarb after setting her up on a double date. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Jean Yarbrough. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired November 12, 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Bank robbers stay the night at Shady Rest hoping to intercept a bank shipment on the Cannonball.Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Sherman Marks. Created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Uncle Joe is pelted with eggs after his team, the Hooterville Hornets, lose a game. Worse, Bedloe is back in town, which is never a good sign. It turns out Bedloe is planning a suroprise inspection with help frmo the railroad. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Kate hires Herby to work as an assistant manager at the hotel, causing Uncle Joe to fear for his position. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: The bank is robbed and the sheriff is killed while everyone is distracted by the wedding between Sand Creeks newspaper editor and a beautiful brunette. The sheriff being the editors best man, the grief-stricken editor begins to escalate the anger towards a suspected drifter with his bias reporting. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie is on the case when homesteaders are forced to sell their land for cheap due to suspicious circumstances. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Tagg Oakley finds himself in trouble after being tricked into driving a wagon full of gunpowder to Fort Yuma, unaware that Geronimo and his Apache braves are waiting for the wagon to pass. Realizing Tagg is in danger, Annie and Lofty race to the rescue. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie writes to the son of an old female pedlar, unaware that he is a member of an outlaw gang, now on their way to Diablo. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. Also starring Slim Pickens. This entertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Mistaken for a notorious outlaw, a young man struggles to convince the townspeople that he didnt commit a stagecoach robbery. Initially, Annie and Susan Meriwether believe him, but his innocence comes into question when he is present during a bank robbery in which the outlaws seem to recognize him. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: With the sheriff off looking for an outlaw, a fake sheriff takes his place, leading to a senseless murder. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This enetertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Waiting to hear whether or not gold has been struck in the mine, Annie discovers a beloved stagecoach is being driven by the daughter of the owner, whos threatening to sell the stage so he can pocket the money. When word comes back that there is no gold in the money, Annie becomes suspicious and begins investigating. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: After a jailed Dobie escapes from jail, Dobie and Tagg find themselves kidnapped, forcing a desperate Annie to rescue her brother. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This entertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Jesse James Rides Again
programme.desc: The outlaw Jesse James and his friend are on the run from the law when he is wrongly accused of leading the historic 1876 Northfield, Minnesota bank robbery. With nerve-tensing turns and high-impact action, Jesse rides into a town where a gang is trying to drive area ranchers off their land because there's oil underneath it. Jesse James takes particular interest in the situation of a pretty young woman and her elderly father, whose ranch is being regularly attacked by the gang.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Loser's End
programme.desc: This spine-tingling drama of the west stars Jack Perrin as a man out for revenge against an outlaw gang. Other stars include Tina Menard as the woman who helps him along the way, and Elias Lazoroff as the daring Don Carlos. Perrin (Jaws of Justice, The Apache Kid's Escape), was a familiar face in low budget westerns, his career spanning back to the silent era.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: William Boyd returns in the 25th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. This time Hopalong goes undercover to expose a group of ranchers who are interfering with the building of a new railroad. Also, look for Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Britt Wood as Speedy McGinnis. It's a great, action-packed adventure from director Leslie Selander (Flight to Mars, Riders of the Range), and further proof that no one pushes Hoppy around and gets away with it!

programme.title: Fighting Caravans
programme.desc: Clint Belmet (Gary Cooper) is a frontier scout with his hands full in this 1931 Paramount Pictures version of Zane Grey's novel. He's helping guide a wagon train across the country, fighting off various attacks on the way, and falling for his lovely Felice (Lily Damita). Belmet's grizzled companions think he should leave the woman alone, but it gets lonely out on the trail, and Felice's charms are hard to resist. Featuring such notable character actors of the period as Ernest Torrence, Tully Marshall, and Fred Kolher, this vintage Hollywood Western still packs a wallop!

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: A band of outlaws is terrorizing a town in the West. Leave it to Ray Crash Corrigan and his Range Busters to ride in and save the day. This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

programme.desc: Valentina Caruso and Francesco Gasparri explore the Strait of Messina, where unique underwater currents create an oceanic ecosystem within the Mediterranean. Diver Domenico Majolino and marine biologist Simona Ratti explain its natural wonders, while Vincenzo Annuario tells the story of the Cariddi ferry, reborn after serving in the navy. At the National Archaeological Museum of Reggio Calabria, we discover the legacy of Magna Grecia and the famous Riace Bronzes. The 1908 earthquake that devastated Messina and Reggio Calabria is commemorated at the Regional Museum of Messina with the exhibition 1908 City Museum.

programme.title: Whats On - 9 - Trade, Exhibitions and Unique Experiences
programme.desc: There is a unique energy that takes over the Mediterranean as the summer heat begins to build. This week, we are bypassing the usual tourist routes to find the heartbeat of the region through its most spectacular festivals. Imagine the sun setting over a lake in Tuscany as the Puccini Festival opens its 72nd season with the powerful melodies of Turandot. From that timeless elegance, we head straight into the high energy of Malta, where the Isle of MTV and the 10th anniversary of the Glitch Festival are turning the islands into a global hub for electronic music. We also explore the stunning heights of the Spanish Pyrenees for the floating stage at Pirineos Sur and hit the iconic cliffs of Santorini for the urban vibes of the Supa Dupa Fly Festival. This is a journey through a region that knows exactly how to celebrate its past while dancing firmly into the future.

programme.title: Fall Guy
programme.desc: Sammy and Austin are childhood friends who have always had each other’s backs right from their teenage years. Their friendship is made in heaven and they will sacrifice almost anything for each other in business, money and women, especially women.

programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: Jealousy rears its ugly head and puts a couple's relationship in jeopardy when they invite guests to stay over in their home.

programme.title: Baby On Board

programme.title: Grip

programme.desc: Detola, a gifted young mechanic, fights to save her late father’s debt-ridden workshop while raising her siblings. When she sparks an unexpected connection with Jarvis, a billionaire heir, their love is tested by his manipulative ex-fiancée Mimi and his mother’s fierce disapproval.

programme.title: Rage
programme.desc: When soft spoken and timid Temisan’s world turns upside down and her former loving husband starts to abuse her physically and verbally. She starts to find a seething rage building up inside her.

programme.title: The Couple
programme.desc: A happily married couple face some challenges when the husband loses his job and a jealous friend makes it her mission to destroy their lives.

programme.title: The Awakening

programme.title: We Tha Boyz
programme.desc: Four jolly teenagers decide to help their friend, Tokunbo, in his plans to get the love of Chioma, however, a rival gang is also vying for her attention. Tokunbo’s parents go out of town and they decide to throw the ultimate house party to impress her. As simple as the plan seems, in reality however, they get in several problems in order to pull it off and end up almost ruining the house.

programme.desc: A long-lost father reappears as a boyfriend. Confused, heartbroken, and desperate for answers, Emily must confront the mystery surrounding her father’s disappearance and his unexpected re-emergence.

programme.title: Private Place
programme.desc: Two couples, faced with trouble in their respective marriages, take drastic action to get back on track.

programme.title: Dying Of Love

programme.title: The Church Boy

programme.title: Lindell - Käärmeenkantaja - Del 1
programme.desc: Ensi hetkestä alkaen Käärmeenkantaja pitää katsojan otteessaan tässä järkyttävässä psykologisessa draamassa, jossa hulluuden logiikka ajaa tapahtumia kohti väistämätöntä kliimaksia. Sarjamurhaaja kulkee vapaana Oslossa.

programme.title: Kaiku
programme.desc: Poliisi Simon on avioeron jälkeen menettänyt huoltajuuden 6-vuotiaaseen poikaansa Louieen. Epätoivon vallassa hän sieppaa pojan ja vie hänet saarelle, missä he piiloutuvat autioon kesämökkiin. Simon haluaa vain viettää viimeisen rauhallisen loman kahden poikansa kanssa.

programme.title: Ohjelmat jatkuvat pian
programme.desc: Olemme pienillä kauneusunilla! Katso lisää Rakuten TV:n tarjoamaa ilmaisviihdettä.

programme.title: Shoo Bre
programme.desc: Vaikka Oscar ja Elias varttuvat samoilla nuhruisilla nurkilla, heidän elämänsä ovat täysin erilaisia. Koulu loppuu pian, ja kumpikin haluaa vaikuttaa omaan tulevaisuuteensa. Silti mikään ei mene kuten he odottivat.

programme.title: Puss
programme.desc: Tukholman takakaduilla joukko kunnianhimoisia tyttöjä pyörittää pientä harrastajateatteria. Eräänä iltana he huomaavat kiinteistön omistajan hiippailevan teatterissa kamera kädessään - ja siitä käynnistyy 48 tunnin mittainen kaoottinen vyyhti täynnä juonitteluja ja kommelluksia.

programme.title: Triple Dare
programme.desc: Rebekka, Claudia ja Sofie ovat lukion 1. luokalla. Vaikka he ovat rippikoulun käyneitä, he huomaavat päivittäin olevansa lapsuuden ja aikuisuuden välimaastossa.

programme.title: Pidä huivista kiinni, Tatjana
programme.desc: Koskenkorvaa litkivä automekaanikko Reino (Matti Pellonpää) ja kahvista riippuvainen peräkamarin poika Valto (Mato Valtonen) lähtevät viettämään viikonloppua ja kohtaavat matkalla virolaisen Tatjanan (Kati Outinen) ja venäläisen Klavdian (Kirsi Tykkyläinen).

programme.title: Alone in Space
programme.desc: Ei niin kovin kaukaisessa tulevaisuudessa valtava avaruuslaiva Svea tekee matkaa mukanaan vain kaksi matkustajaa - 12-vuotias Gladys ja hänen pikkuveljensä Keaton.

programme.title: Rosa Morena
programme.desc: Thomas on lähtenyt Brasiliaan lomalle, mutta asiaan liittyykin jotain muuta. Thomas nimittäin kaipaa kovasti erästä asiaa: hän haluaa tulla isäksi.

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Paavo Ylönen kuuluu yläluokkaiseen Gourmet Clubiin, johon jokainen jäsen tuo vuorollaan eksoottisen raaka-aineen. Se, joka tunnistaa mikä kätkeytyy gourmet-annokseen, voittaa suuren summan rahaa.

programme.title: The King Of Ping Pong
programme.desc: Rille ja Erik asuvat äidin kanssa, jonka pojat aavistavat olevan suhteessa Gunnariin - mitä he eivät hyväksy. Talvilomalla Rille järjestää pöytätennisturnauksen nuorisotalolla, mutta kun isä ilmestyy, Rillellä on paljon muuta mielessä.

programme.title: Original
programme.desc: Henry on elämän kalpea kopio. Nuori pankkivirkailija yrittää niin innokkaasti sopeutua muiden odotuksiin, että hän on jo kauan sitten kadottanut itsensä. Sitten Jon ilmestyy tyhjästä ja houkuttelee Henryn lähtemään mukaan Espanjaan avaamaan aidon bodegan.

programme.title: Leningrad Cowboys go America
programme.desc: Leningrad Cowboys Go America kertoo maailman huonoimman rock-yhtyeen matkasta Siperian tundralta Yhdysvaltojen kautta Meksikoon despoottisen managerinsa Vladimirin (Matti Pellonpää) johdolla. Elokuvasta sukeutui kansainvälinen menestys ja se nosti Leningrad Cowboys -yhtyeen maailmanmaineeseen.

programme.title: Umeå4Ever
programme.desc: Stian on 31-vuotias, hän on pitkään etsinyt rakkautta ja vähitellen laskenut vaatimuksiaan niin paljon, että on valmis tyytymään naiseen, joka huolii hänet.

programme.title: Pyromaani
programme.desc: Pyromaani sytyttää ensimmäisen tulipalonsa pienessä kylässä. Yhä isommat ja vaarallisemmat palot levittävät pelkoa pienessä yhteisössä.

programme.title: Kaalbringenin Kurkunleikkaaja
programme.desc: Jossain piileksii murhaaja, jonka itseluottamus kasvaa hetki hetkeltä. Pieni eurooppalainen rannikkokaupunki, Kaalbringen, on kauhun vallassa. Kuten myös Maardam. Lyhyen ajan sisällä kaupunkeja on järkyttänyt kaksi raakaa murhaa. Missä ja milloin ”kurkunleikkaaja” iskee seuraavaksi?

programme.title: Ruotsalainen Avioliitto
programme.desc: Erland on töissä pikkupaikkakunnan paperitehtaassa parhaan ystävänsä Sven-Erikin kanssa. Vapaa-aikana hän pitää seurakunnan avioliittokoulua yhdessä vaimonsa Mayn kanssa. Eräissä juhlissa Erland rakastuu tulisesti Sven-Erikin vaimoon Kariniin.

programme.title: Helmiä Ja Sikoja
programme.desc: Hirvoset, neljä veljestä ja isäukko, elelevätJoensuun Rantakylässä ja pyörittävätpienimuotoista bisnestä Pimeetä viinaa japikkusuolasta.

programme.title: Over The Edge
programme.desc: David ja Freja ovat mielettömän rakastuneita ja muuttavat unelmataloonsa Mønin saarelle. Pian idylli särkyy selittämättömän itsemurhan jälkeen. David päättää selvittää mysteerin, mutta mitä lähemmäs totuutta hän pääsee, sitä kauemmas hän etääntyy Frejasta.

programme.title: I Miss You
programme.desc: Identtiset kaksoset Cilla jaTina ovat hyvin läheiset mutta samalla valtavan erilaiset. Cilla on taiteilijasielu ja idealisti, joka kulkee omia teitään, kun taas Tina on suosittu, puberteettinen ja jatkuvasti rakastunut.

programme.title: Le Havre
programme.desc: Parhaan elokuvan Jussi-palkinnon voittaja ja myös kansainvälisesti palkittu elokuva, voitti myös 2011 Cannesin elokuvajuhlilla, elokuvakriitikkojen järjestön Fiprescin palkinnon, parhaan koiranäyttelijän sekä ekumeenisen tuomariston palkinnot.

programme.title: Anti
programme.desc: On vuosi 1991. Simon ja hänen paras kaverinsa Frede asuvat pikkupaikkakunnalla Kööpenhaminan lähistöllä toivomatta tulevaisuudelta muuta kuin uutta sätkää. Simon on aina pitänyt piirtämisestä, muttei ole koskaan ajatellut, että taidosta olisi jotain hyötyä.

programme.title: Ykköset Ja Nollat - Osa 1
programme.desc: Kriitikoiden ylistämä brutaali gangsteridraama Johan Renckiltä! FBI ja Interpol saavat vihiä suuresta luottokorttisotkusta, ja narkkari Sebbe napataan kiinni epäiltynä. Poliisin aloittaessa kuulustelun he saavat kuulla uskomattoman tarinan Göteborgin alamaailmasta.

programme.title: Mies vailla menneisyyttä
programme.desc: Mies vailla menneisyyttä kertoo muistinsa menettävästä miehestä, joka aloittaa elämänsä alusta yhteiskunnan köyhimpien keskellä. Mies vailla menneisyyttä sai Cannesin elokuvajuhlien Grand Prix -palkinnon ja Kati Outinen palkittiin roolisuorituksestaan parhaan naisnäyttelijän palkinnolla.

programme.title: Beyond Dreams
programme.desc: Mirja (Evin Ahmad) etsii paikkaansa maailmassa vankilasta päästyään. Saatuaan töitä hotellisiivoojana hän alkaa elää kaksoiselämää. Hänen sairas äitinsä ja vanhat ystävänsä, jotka ovat olleet hänen oikea perheensä, repivät häntä kahtaalle.

programme.title: Gourmet Club
programme.desc: Paavo Ylönen kuuluu yläluokkaiseen Gourmet Clubiin, johon jokainen jäsen tuo vuorollaan eksoottisen raaka-aineen. Se, joka tunnistaa mikä kätkeytyy gourmet-annokseen, voittaa suuren summan rahaa.

programme.title: Puss
programme.desc: Tukholman takakaduilla joukko kunnianhimoisia tyttöjä pyörittää pientä harrastajateatteria. Eräänä iltana he huomaavat kiinteistön omistajan hiippailevan teatterissa kamera kädessään - ja siitä käynnistyy 48 tunnin mittainen kaoottinen vyyhti täynnä juonitteluja ja kommelluksia.

programme.title: Tulen Morsian
programme.desc: Ahvenanmaan noitavainot vuonna 1666. Kätilö Valpurin kasvattityttärestä Annasta koulutetaan kylän seuraavaa parantajaa. Nuori Anna valitsee kuitenkin piian pestin uuden kihlakunnantuomarin Psilanderin palveluksessa.

programme.title: Lindell: Unenvartija - Osa 1
programme.desc: Unenvartija on sietämättömän jännittävä rikostarina, jossa psykologiset pohjasävyt kuljettavat tapahtumia eteenpäin, kunnes kaikki päättyy dramaattiseen kilpajuoksuun häikäilemättömän murhaajan kanssa.

programme.title: Hullujen Talo
programme.desc: Hullujen talo on vaikuttava ja omaperäinen draama, joka perustuu Karin Fossumin samannimiseen romaaniin. Vaikka Fossum tunnetaan ennen kaikkea rikoskirjallisuudestaan, Hullujen talo on jotakin aivan muuta.

programme.title: Lindell - Käärmeenkantaja - Del 1

programme.desc: Bobbie Dobkins' arrest for hiring a male prostitute exposes some unorthodox steps she's taken to improve her sex life. Grayson fights to keep a client's divorce case from being moved to Wyoming.

programme.title: Jane's Secret Revealed
programme.desc: Amid concerns about her mother's health, Jane takes on an Amish farmer's fight against fracking. Grayson represents a dominatrix who's suing a deadbeat client, while Stacy asks Owen to help get their child into a good preschool.

programme.title: Truth And Consequences
programme.desc: As she struggles to learn how much Grayson knows about her and Deb, Jane uncovers a dark secret that could land a client in prison. Old tensions are renewed between Owen and his estranged brother when he asks Owen to sue a strip club.

programme.title: Soulmates
programme.desc: While Jane fights for an innocent man’s parole, Grayson and the firm’s new lawyer claim a cruise ship line’s negligence caused their client’s divorce. Grayson confronts the truth about Deb and Jane.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming?
programme.desc: Bobbie Dobkins' arrest for hiring a male prostitute exposes some unorthodox steps she's taken to improve her sex life. Grayson fights to keep a client's divorce case from being moved to Wyoming.

programme.title: Finale, Part 2
programme.desc: Fran delivers her twins as C.C. gives Niles an answer to his marriage proposal.

programme.title: The Nanny - Pilot
programme.desc: A door-to-door cosmetics saleswoman falls into a job as a wealthy family's nanny.

programme.title: The Nuchshlep
programme.desc: Fran's help getting Maggie a date backfires.

programme.title: Smoke Gets In Your Lies
programme.desc: Brighton is caught smoking at school.

programme.title: Here Comes The Brood
programme.desc: Jealous of Fran, C.C. tries to court favor with Maxwell's children.

programme.title: Personal Business
programme.desc: Fran is enlisted to help land a soap opera star for Maxwell's musical.

programme.title: Imaginary Friend
programme.desc: Fran accidentally kills Grace's imaginary friend.

programme.title: The Butler
programme.desc: Fran persuades the family to help her dupe a nosy cousin.

programme.title: My Fair Nanny
programme.desc: Fran hosts a society tea for debutante Maggie.

programme.title: The Christmas Show
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.title: The Nanny-In-Law
programme.desc: Fran contends with Maxwell's old nanny.

programme.title: A Plot For Nanny
programme.desc: Fran's birthday gift leads to a date with a handsome mortician.

programme.title: The Show Must Go On
programme.desc: Fran and Maxwell clash over Grace's school pageant.

programme.title: Maggie The Model
programme.desc: Chloe Simpson, a 1960s supermodel, re-enters ex-flame Maxwell's life, turning the Sheffield household upside down and interfering with the relationship between Fran and Maggie.

programme.title: The Family Plumbing
programme.desc: Maxwell reveals he has a double standard when it comes to his children and the opposite sex.

programme.title: Deep Throat
programme.desc: While examining Grace for symptoms of the flu, the doctor takes a look at Fran's throat and immediately orders her to the hospital to have her tonsils removed. Meanwhile, C.C. convinces Maxwell to attend her college reunion -- as her amour, but her plans are foiled when Maxwell stands her up in order to stay by Fran's bedside.

programme.title: Schlepped Away
programme.desc: The entire Sheffield clan, including C.C. and Fran, spends the weekend vacationing at Fran's parents' house when a blizzard closes the airports and maroons them in Queens. While stranded at the Fines' home, Maggie falls for the boy next door, C.C. crawls in bed with Niles, and Fran finds a love note to her mother -- that's not from her father.

programme.title: Stop The Wedding, I Want To Get Off
programme.desc: Maxwell's sister Jocelyn gets engaged to Nigel, the Duke of Salisbury, but the wedding seems ill-fated after Fran discovers that Jocelyn is really in love with her chauffeur, Lester.

programme.title: Sunday In The Park With Fran
programme.desc: Grace and the son of a prominent theater critic Frank Bradley get in a fight during a trip to the park, and, to break it up, Fran bops the boy with a baguette -- which could mean curtains for Maxwell's newest Broadway play.

programme.title: The Gym Teacher
programme.desc: Fran's nightmare high school gym teacher has a new job as Maggie's instructor -- and Fran goes back to school to help Maggie pass her gymnastics final.

programme.title: Ex-Factor
programme.desc: Joy's interest in Eddie soars after learning that he dated her classy new friend before they were married.

programme.title: Snore Loser
programme.desc: After Kenny's complaints about his snoring send Eddie to a sleep clinic for a cure, Joy discovers that she can't sleep without all the noise.

programme.title: The Perfect Couple
programme.desc: Joy invites a new couple for dinner, only to be left out after they become Eddie's new best friends.

programme.title: Ally Abroad
programme.desc: After a car accident lands Doug at their house to recover, Eddie and Joy look for a way to head off his sudden plans to marry their daughter.

programme.title: Family Vacation
programme.desc: After agreeing to take Doug and Kenny along on their family vacation to Florida, Joy and Eddie's bickering causes a bride-to-be to have second thoughts about getting married.

programme.title: Dog Fight
programme.desc: The Starks employ role playing to spice up their sex life, while Kenny looks to make a career out of returning lost pets to their grateful owners.

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Eddie is resigned to enduring a visit from his gay brother Charlie and his boyfriend, only to be surprised at how much he has in common with Charlie's new partner.

programme.title: Can't Elope
programme.desc: Joy's manic wedding planning tries Eddie's patience and leads Allison and Doug to elope.

programme.title: Your Witch Is Showing
programme.desc: When Darrin refuses to allow Samantha to act as matron of honor at cousin's wedding in Egypt, Endora tells him he's in trouble. Immediately Darrin starts having problems with his campaign to get the Woolfe Brothers Department Store account. despite Darrin's protests, Larry Tate gives him an assistant. The assistant, young Gideon Whitsett, soon maneuvers himself into being regarded as a brilliant young man. On the make, Gideon soon has Woolfe looking to him for ideas, which he has stolen from Darrin. Darrin is sure that Gideon is a warlock whom Endora has assigned to take his job. When everything else fails, Samantha decides to stop Gideon herself. Using witchcraft, Samantha gets Gideon to reveal the ruthless maneuvers he has been using to get Darrin's job. Darrin, who overhears the conversation, finally realizes Gideon is not a warlock. A right to the jaw puts Gideon out of action. His confidence restored, Darrin sells Mr. Woolfe on his idea for a successful campaign.

programme.title: Ling Ling
programme.desc: Darrin's agency is unable to find a model for the Jewel of the East campaign. Darrin hopes they'll be able to do so, if only to bolster the confidence of Wally Ames, who is sub-stituting for the company's top photographer. Samantha trans-forms the Stephens' cat into a beautiful Oriental girl named Ling Ling. Everyone flips over her and the campaign is wrapped up. Darrin invites Larry and Louise Tate and Wally to a victory celebration at his home. Wally, intrigued by Ling Ling's feline grace, brings her along. Samantha's efforts to make Ling Ling give up Wally fail. To avoid a catastrophe, Samantha is forced to tell Darrin and asks him to warn Wally off, but Wally only becomes angry with Darrin. Samantha spikes Ling Ling's drink with truth serum. Wally bows out when Ling Ling displays her true cat nature. Later, Gladys Kravitz calls her husband when she sees Ling Ling clad in a mink coat, lapping milk from a saucer. By the time Abner gets to the window, Samantha has returned Ling Ling to her original state, and Abner gives his wife a spoonful of her nerve medicine.

programme.title: Eye Of The Beholder
programme.desc: Endora, hoping to break up her daughter's marriage, superimposes Samantha's face on a print entitled Maid of Salem: the print is dated 1690. Darrin buys the print and then begins to worry about the difference between Samantha's age and his own. With Endora planting seeds of doubt at every turn, Darrin visualizes himself as a doddering old man, while Samantha retains her youthful appearance. Everyone, including Larry Tate and the doctor from whom Darrin seeks advice, fails to realize what is troubling him. Then, in a nearby park, Darrin overhears two squirrels to which Endora has given voice talk about their dif-ferences in age. Endora finally admits to Samantha that she can age along with Darrin. Samantha, after telling Darrin she never posed for the picture, tells him that her mother is to blame for their problem. She assures him that they will grow old together, but being in love will never note the difference. As insurance, Samantha uses witchcraft to make the Maid of Salem disappear.

programme.title: Red Light, Green Light
programme.desc: The lack of a traffic signal at busy Morning Glory Circle makes it virtually impossible for the Stephens or their neighbors to cross without risking life and limb. Joe Harvey calls a meeting at his home to discuss plans for doing something about it. Darrin makes an ad for a mass rally at the school auditorium to force City Hall to put a traffic light on the corner. However, Samantha has trouble getting Endora to return the traffic signals she has collected. Endora even brings a London bobby to the Stephens' living room. The bobby, of course, has disappeared by the time Gladys Kravitz brings her husband to see him. At the rally, the Mayor tells his constituents a traffic light is unnecessary. However, using her witchcraft, Samantha has the Mayor and his limousine so tied up in a traffic jam that he is convinced a traffic signal is necessary. Endora, as a final touch, brings a modern traffic signal to the Stephens home for the victory celebration. Gladys sees it, but by the time she brings Abner, Samantha makes Endora cause it to vanish.

programme.title: Which Witch Is Which?
programme.desc: Samantha tells Endora she doesn't have time for a dress-fitting. Endora solves Samantha's problem by transforming herself into En-Sam, identical to Samantha. Bob Frazer, an author, falls for En-Sam and they do the town together. Meanwhile, Darrin tells Samantha to expect a visit from his friend, Bob Frazer. Gladys Kravitz, who has seen En-Sam with Bob, is sure the Stephens home is about to break up. After Bob sees Samantha and mistakes her for En-Sam, Samantha explains to Endora the trouble she is causing. Endora is convinced when she learns Bob is expected at the Stephens home. All of En-Sam's efforts to break with Bob fail. Bob is determined to have a showdown with Darrin over Samantha. Samantha tells Darrin that Bob has fallen in love with Endora. Endora, still En-Sam, arrives and Bob thinks En-Sam and Samantha are identical twins. Although Endora promises to give Bob Up, Samantha, knowing her mother, is not sure what she will do.

programme.title: Pleasure O'riley
programme.desc: Samantha and Gladys Kravitz become aware of their husbands' interest in Priscilla Pleasure O'Riley, a beautiful model, when she buys a house next door. Pleasure is hiding from Thor Thunderbolt Swenson, an offensive fullback who has threatened mayhem if he sees her with another man. Darrin becomes involved in Pleasure's affairs after he helps her move in. One night, Pleasure wakes up the Stephens. Telling them that Thunderbolt has learned her new address, she pleads for Darrin's protection. Thunderbolt arrives and Samantha inadvertently gives him the impression that Darrin is Pleasure's new boyfriend. Darrin is saved from Thunderbolt's wrath when Samantha turns him into the image of his grandmother. Then, certain that Abner is the man, Thunderbolt knocks him out and is arrested. Gladys hits the headlines when the newspapers mistakenly single her out as the object of Thunderbolt's jealousy. Pleasure's lawyer gets a court order to keep Thunderbolt away. However, Pleasure accepts Thunderbolt's offer to drive her to the Mayor's office where she is to pose as Miss Urban Renewal.

programme.title: Driving Is The Only Way To Fly
programme.desc: After a violent argument while he is teaching her to drive, Darrin enrolls Samantha in a driving school. Basil Koenig assigns his brother-in-law Harold, one of humanity's leading nervous wrecks, to teach Samantha. Time after time, Samantha uses witchcraft to get the dual-controlled car out of catastrophic predicaments. Harold finally breaks when he hears Endora's voice from the back seat and is unable to see her. Harold leaves Samantha, Endora, and the car and heads for a psychiatrist. Feeling responsible, Samantha takes Darrin to the school to keep Harold from losing his job. Matters get more complicated when Darrin tries to explain Endora's unseen presence. Although Koenig has already fired Harold, he rehires him when Samantha threatens to go to another driving school. After Darrin learns Samantha has cured Harold's nervousness by getting him to join a class in basket weaving, Darrin decides to join, too.

programme.title: There's No Witch Like An Old Witch
programme.desc: Age has played havoc with Aunt Clara's witchcraft. Unable to fly great distances any longer, she is forced to give up a trip to Miami with the other witches. Samantha invites her to stay at the Stephens' home while they are away. All of Aunt Clara's efforts to help around the house prove disastrous. To cheer her up, Samantha and Darrin take her along for an evening on the town with the Caldwells. However, when the babysitter does not arrive, Aunt Clara insists on substituting. Aunt Clara's magic...

programme.title: Open The Door, Witchcraft
programme.desc: Inspired by a demonstration of an electric garage door, Samantha opens her garage by twitching her nose. Plagued by Gladys about this, Abner questions Darrin. To cover up, Darrin foregoes new fishing gear and buys a remote control for the garage. When radio signals from passing planes operate the door at random, Samantha asks Darrin to return the device and use the money for fishing gear. Darrin refuses to believe Samantha and she swears never to use magic again. Later, Samantha and Darrin are t...

programme.title: Abner Kadabra
programme.desc: Gladys Kravitz catches Samantha twitching her nose to rearrange pictures on a wall.

programme.title: Happy Anniversary
programme.desc: Jeannie wants to celebrate the first anniversary of meeting Tony on the desert island where they met. Preparing for a space flight, Tony forgets the date. Annoyed, Jeannie makes his capsule land on the island where Tony finds a bottle.

programme.title: Always On Sunday
programme.desc: Tony tells Jeannie it's too bad every day can't be Sunday. Feeling Tony is overworked, Jeannie blinks and it becomes Sunday. She tells a horrified Tony it will be Sunday until he is rested.

programme.title: My Master, The Rich Tycoon
programme.desc: While Tony is at the Base, Harry Huggins comes to his nose. He tells Jeannie the house is tiny and the furniture shoddy. To impress him, Jeannie blinks and turns the house into a luxurious mansion, with world famous art works, a safe full of money and a staff of servants.

programme.title: My Master, The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Tony tells Jeannie he enjoys cold weather. She starts a snowstorm and the flakes fall on Dr. Bellows. Determined to discover the explanation for the strange happenings around Tony, Dr. Bellows tells Gen. Peterson

programme.title: My Wild
programme.desc: Tony strains his eyes while studying for a sub-orbital flight. Dr. Bellows orders him to take an eye test the following morning. Tony emphatically turns down Roger's suggestion that he get Jeannie's help in passing the examination.

programme.title: What's New Poodle Dog
programme.desc: Roger tells Jeannie that he has arranged a double date for Tony and himself with two beauty queens. Before Roger can tell Tony, Jeannie turns him into a French poodle. The poodle is taken to the dog pound. There, Tony pays five dollars for a Great Dane he thinks is Roger.

programme.title: Fastest Gun In The East
programme.desc: Watching a TV western, Tony longs for the days when a man had to be strong to survive. Jeannie blinks and Tony finds he is a U.S. Marshal in a frontier town. Confronted by a bang of outlaws led by Bull Welch, Tony is saved by Horace Sedgewick, the town banker.

programme.title: How To Be A Genie In 10 Easy Lessons
programme.desc: Tony complains that Jeannie is constantly getting him into trouble. She replies she's not had much practice at being a genie. Tony takes Roger's suggestion that Jeannie needs lessors in her craft and buys The Arabian Nights.

programme.title: Who Needs A Green
programme.desc: Jeannie's jealousy takes over when Tony insists on keeping a date with a friend. She blinks and Tony finds himself behind bars in his living room. Feeling she has been successful in keeping Tony from his date, she releases him the following morning.

programme.title: The Girl Who Never Had A Birthday, Pt. 1
programme.desc: Jeannie tells Tony she never had a birthday party since she does not know when she was born. Tony sends her back home to find out. At the base, Gen. Peterson and Dr. Bellows introduce Tony to Eric, a huge computer.

programme.title: The Girl Who Never Had A Birthday, Pt. 2
programme.desc: Tony and Roger make another attempt to have Eric, the com-puter figure out Jeannie's birthday. Since Tony is scheduled to leave for Alaska on a mission, Dr. Bellows uses Tony' s office while his own is being painted.

programme.title: How Do You Beat Superman
programme.desc: With the football season in full swing, Tony is constantly glued to the TV set. Jeannie realizes she must do something to get his attention and decides to make Tony jealous.

programme.title: My Master, The Great Caruso
programme.desc: Tony tells Jeannie that each year the American Air Force puts on a TV talent show with contestants from each base. Jeannie insists that Tony enter since they need a trophy for the mantle.

programme.title: The Greatest Lover In The World
programme.desc: Roger cancels a double date with Tony and Jeannie. Surmising that Roger has been unable to get a date for himself, Jeannie blinks. Immediately Roger's phone gets busy with calls from girls who turned him down, and a score of new ones, begging for dates.

programme.title: Jeannie Breaks The Bank
programme.desc: Because Jeannie has run up a staggering food bill, Tony is unable to join Roger in buying a sailboat. Jeannie goes to the bank with Tony to borrow money for his share.

programme.title: My Master, The Author
programme.desc: Tony complains that he has no free time because Jeannie waits him to spend every spare moment with her. Roger suggests he find Jeannie a hobby, but she turns down all his suggestions, until she mentions that she could write a book on raising children.

programme.title: Dancin' Angels
programme.desc: A dance marathon with $5,000 in prize money attracts Joe and Sally Fairgate to compete, but when Sally disappears, Joe enlists the Angels' help in finding her. They investigate and question suspects, promoter P.J. Wilkes, investor Al Norman and leading dance couple, Steve and Jenny. Bosley discovers that Norman is a small time racketeer and Steve is a convicted hood from New York. The Angels approach the suspects to find motives for Sally's murder, making Wilkes and Norman very nervous. But when dance band singer, Billy, is found dead after an altercation with band leader Elton Mills, Kelly mistakenly confronts Mills, who confines her until he can kill her later. Wilkes and Norman admit moving Sally's body after Mills killed her. The Angels busy themselves searching for Kelly. She escapes from Mills and following a brief shootout, he is captured by the Angels, ending his attempt at a comeback as a dance band leader.

programme.title: Harrigan's Angel
programme.desc: When Starrett Electronics is the victim of a second large heist, Paul Starrett's insurance company insists he have additional help for Joseph Harrigan, a bumbling, disheveled private investigator covering the case. The Angels investigation develops leads and they question photo engraver Belkin materials and shipper Felber, who both have police records linked to Starrett. Kris and Harrigan figured out the heist method but Starrett has already ordered them killed. The Angels confront and arrest Starrett for robbing his own business. They then rush to Harrigan's apartment in time to capture Felber and Belkin attempting to kill Harrigan.

programme.title: An Angel's Trail
programme.desc: Jill Munroe is taken hostage when she accidentally stumbles into a gas station robbery. Convict Sam Mason and his sons, Clint and Harley, escape into the desolate desert hills keeping Jill tied in the back of their getaway van. Tiffany researches the geography of the highlands and discovers an old road overlooked by the search party. Hampered by wind and rain, Kris continues to lead the search for her sister when they find indications that the convicts are nearby. Jill befriends the retarded Harley who retaliates against his cruel father by battering Sam unconscious -- saving Jill from certain death. Jill sees that Harley receives special attention in the best institution for the mentally handicapped.

programme.title: Nips And Tucks
programme.desc: When a Congressional witness is found dead, the Angels investigate plastic surgeon Paul Redmont's association with racketeer Vern Maddox, who they learn wants plastic surgery to change his identity. Redmont's girlfriend and former revolutionary, Barbara Brown, arranges for Maddox's surgery. programme.title: Three For The Money
programme.desc: When three unsuspecting investors are bilked by racketeer, Harley Dexter, the Angels scheme to con Dexter into returning the money. Kelly persuades Dexter to use laundered syndicate money to buy her truckload of Mayan artifacts; Kris works an ingenious switch of her worthless Rolls Royce for Dexter's Rolls and Tiffany poses as a Senator's aide demanding payment to stop the Senator's investigation of Dexter's syndicate ties. Dexter is ruined when the syndicate realizes that the Maya artifacts are phony. Kris Rolls Royce is junked and the Senator arranges a Grand Jury injunction against Dexter. programme.title: Toni's Boys

programme.title: One Love… Two Angels, Part 1

programme.title: Harrigan's Angel
